    connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id2 = c.atom_id

    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

    m.label = '-' OR (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) > 5

    COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) > 5
